verdict.rationale: The user-authored artifacts are in open, portable formats. Skills are plain directories with a `SKILL.md` file plus optional scripts, stored in `.agents/skills` folders in the repo. Plugins use a `plugin.json` manifest, and a portable Agent Plugins schema exists alongside a Claude Code migration path, so these assets could be taken elsewhere. Missing for 10: any documented export of account data (installed plugins, plugin-held data, chat or work history), any bulk export tool or documented exit/offboarding process, and independent confirmation that leaving works in practice.
